headline: Vote on 2027-28 school calendar, plus review of policies on service animals and animals in schools.
summary: The committee will discuss and vote on the 2027-28 calendar, hold a first discussion on the ACAC policy for service animals in schools, and hold a second discussion on the new IMG policy for animals in schools.
items: Policy ACAC - Service Animals in Schools (Review - First Discussion)
Policy IMG - Animals in Schools (Draft New - Second Discussion)
